column1: # mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings from the gist minimal upper ontology (Semantic Arts) to the ISO/IEC 22989:2022 (Artificial intelligence concepts and terminology) LinkML schema. They relate gist's Organization, Person, Event, Task and related foundational classes to ISO/IEC 22989 terms, to support integration with gist-based knowledge graphs.

column10: The ISO/IEC 22989 schema limits Organization to one that establishes and operates an AI management system.
AIUser is a stakeholder role, which an organization can also fill.
DataSubject is a stakeholder role held by a person or a group whose personal data an AI system processes.
AI lifecycle processes are happenings situated in time and are subtypes of gist event.
The ISO/IEC 22989 Task is a kind of AI task, such as classification, rather than a piece of work.
Data processes are events transforming or moving data.
An ISO/IEC 22989 action is carried out as a result of an AI-system decision, a narrower kind of event.
A decision is a determination among alternatives.
A knowledge graph is composed of knowledge concepts and their relations.
